clips.title: The story
paras: In Elwynn Forest, kobolds gather and hoard flecks of gold in the mines. Local buyers pay for the dust, while miners seek whole veins of ore.

Kobolds dig through the Fargodeep and Jasperlode mines beneath Elwynn Forest. They keep the gold dust they find in pockets and pouches instead of refining it. Local peddlers and fences want these scraps, hoping to profit without paying official smelting tariffs.
